description_en: Completely cleans up an instance that has been deleted (within the last 7 days) but not fully cleaned up
description_zh: 针对已删除（未超过7天）但未完全清理的实例
name: PurgeInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the deleted cluster to be cleaned up. You can call the DescribeDeletedInstances operation to obtain the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh: 要清理的已删除的集群Id，可通过DescribeDeletedInstances接口获取
parameters.name: cluster_id
